text:
英语词汇 · 考研 · 第 459 单元

affect
音标：英 /ə'fekt/  美 /ə'fɛkt/
vt. 影响；感动， 感染
例句：the areas affected by the hurricane
受飓风影响的地区
例句：a disease that affects the central nervous system
影响中枢神经系统的疾病
例句：decisions which affect our lives
影响我们生活的决定
例句：Trading has been adversely affected by the downturn in consumer spending.
贸易受到消费支出回落的不利影响。

deaf
音标：英 /def/  美 /dɛf/
adj. 聋的；不愿听的
短语：turn a deaf ear — 充耳不闻；不加理睬；不愿听
短语：deaf ears — （鸡的）耳朵
短语：deaf and dumb — 聋哑的，又聋又哑
短语：deaf mute — 聋哑人；聋哑的
短语：partially deaf — 听力部分残疾
例句：communication between deaf and hearing people
失聪者和听力正常者之间的交流
例句：I think Mum’s going a bit deaf .
我觉得妈妈有点耳聋了。
例句：She’s deaf and dumb (= unable to hear or speak ) and communicates using sign language.
她又聋又哑，用手语交流。
例句：Tom was born profoundly deaf (= having great difficulty hearing ) .
汤姆天生几乎全聋。

amuse
